name: @wellsfargo-starui/apps
description: Consumer/reference apps for @wellsfargo-starui. Two tracks: source/ resolves @wellsfargo-starui/* out of the platform checkout, tarball/ installs the packed bucket tarballs the way an external team would. Never deployed.
//platform-link: file:../stern-bak points at the platform repo checkout sitting beside this one. Rename the path if your checkout is named differently. It is what makes @wellsfargo-starui/platform/scripts/* and tsconfig.consumer.json importable.

scripts.build: npm run build:source && npm run build:tarball
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:source && npm run typecheck:tarball

//types-note: React types live at the repo root so every app — and the package .d.ts they pull in — sees exactly one copy. Two @types/react in one graph produce spurious JSX type conflicts.
